'''2005 North Dakota State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship held on Saturday 25 June 2005 at Paradox Comic and Cards, 26 Roberts St, Fargo, North Dakota, with [[Nick Kolnik]] named as tentative tournament director.<ref name="pcf-5018-68750">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=68750#68750 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Brian Herold (thepityofmrt), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Tyler Vastag]] took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2005 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Paradox Comic and Cards, 26 Roberts St, Fargo, North Dakota<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Dates:''' 25 June 2005<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Time:''' registration 10:30 am; start 11 am<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Format:''' six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]] (tentative)<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Prizes:''' prizes for everyone, including at least the Players Committee's Ultimate Package, under which the winner could design a virtual card<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Tyler Vastag]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

== Organization ==

[[Brian Herold]] announced the event on 4 April 2005 and gave himself and Tyler Vastag as contacts; he thanked [[Michael Raveling|Mike Raveling]] for the Ultimate Package.<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" /> Herold recalled a turnout of "32, I believe" at the [[2004 North Dakota State Championship|2004 event]]. He wrote that 25 June suited most of the players they had asked, including Kolnik.<ref name="pcf-5018-70672">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=70672#70672 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Brian Herold (thepityofmrt), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Vastag wrote that it had been very hard to find a weekend that worked and hoped to top 32 players with the low entry fee and the Ultimate Package.<ref name="pcf-5018-70833">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=70833#70833 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Tyler Vastag (tvas27), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
